Welcome to the hotkey creation wizard. This wizard will guide you through the process of creating your very own hotkeys and walk you through every step of the process in detail.

To start off, two hotkey types are offered to you. The first type works just like you would imagine a regular hotkey to work : it executes a certain command when you press it, but it also keeps executing it repeatedly as it is held down.
Choose a category and the action to be performed by this hotkey from the list.
Choose a condition to accompany the command you just created if you want it to execute in some specific circumstances only. Sometimes, no condition is necessary. You can also stack conditions.

Behold is the entire command that you have created so far. It is possible to add multiple commands to a key and have it perform those actions at once (sometimes, both won't execute due to conditions, but they will at least be attempted).
